definitions.explanation: Transportation service that picks up and drops off people, commonly offered by hotels, airports, and various facilities.

notes:
FORMATION:
{送|そう} (sending off) + {迎|げい} (going to meet). The word covers both directions of a trip — taking someone there and collecting them again.

VERB FORM:
{送迎|そうげい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to provide pickup and drop-off
